about_the_game:
Deductive Reasoning & Map-Making

Back in the land of your childhood, your royal mission is of the utmost importance: you must map the remote area and draw a border that will restore peace. Your observant eye, your analytical skills, and the measurements you take will be the only tools at your disposal for filling in your empty map.

Discussions & Dilemmas

Whether hostile or friendly, every person you come across will have a secret to tell you or a request to make. The consequences of defining a border between kingdoms are far-reaching, and you'll have to juggle the needs of the locals with your official duties.

Exploration & Investigation

As you continue your survey of the land, you'll start to notice strange phenomena and signs of a secret plot against you. There's much more here than just a map: your forgotten promises, your childhood sweetheart, the history of the land you stand on. Will your sketches bring peace or chaos?

short_description: Map a mysterious land during the Age of Enlightenment. Draw the border between two warring kingdoms. Meet the locals. Juggle their demands with the requirements of your mission. Ethical dilemmas, secret plots, strange phenomena… will you be able to bring peace back to the land?
